name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood visits to Silverstone. He began his career as a junior engineer with a small Formula Ford team, quickly demonstrating an aptitude for data analysis and problem-solving. He honed his skills through various roles in touring cars before landing at Dick Johnson Racing. 

Alistair is known for his meticulous approach to race preparation. He believes in a data-driven approach, but also values the driver's feedback. He is respected for his clear communication style under pressure, and his ability to quickly identify and address issues during races. His relentless pursuit of perfection, while sometimes challenging for the team, ultimately drives performance improvements.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a specific order in which he reviews telemetry data before each session.
Insists on having a perfectly clean and organized workspace.
